summary: SPK RC 52 them muc Kich ban (soan thao kieu Google Docs, binh luan theo luong), tai video goc va tai ca du an thanh file ZIP.
changes: Muc Kich ban moi, nam canh Du an va Lich: soan thao kieu Google Docs voi tieu de, phong chu, co chu, mau chu, to nen, can le, danh sach, checklist, lien ket va bang (them/xoa hang cot, gop/tach o, hang tieu de, keo doi do rong cot). Tu dong luu; neu hai nguoi cung sua, nguoi luu sau duoc chon giu ban nao, khong bi ghi de am tham.

Binh luan kich ban kieu Google Docs: boi den mot doan de binh luan dung cho, tra loi theo luong, danh dau da giai quyet / mo lai, sua va xoa binh luan cua minh. Trang thai duyet: Nhap, Cho duyet, Da duyet.
Gan kich ban vao du an bang menu moi co o tim kiem; trang du an hien cac kich ban da gan va nut 'Viet kich ban'. Tai khoan khach khong thay muc Kich ban.
Tai video: nut tai ban goc o tung video, va nut 'Tai tat ca' dong goi ca du an thanh mot file ZIP (khong nen, khong tao file tam tren NAS, ho tro file tren 4GB, toi da 2 luot tai ZIP cung luc).
Sua loi: tai lai trang (F5) o Lich, mot du an hay bat ky trang nao khong con bi day ve trang Du an; header du an va cac tab tu xuong dong tren dien thoai.
